entities.summary: Kittitian, a notable figure in the history of Saint Kitts and Nevis, associated with Labour Movement and Path to Independence (1952–1978). Preceded by Federation, Associated Statehood, and Bradshaw Era and West Indies Federation. Their legacy influenced Independence of Saint Kitts and Nevis — September 19, 1983 and Kennedy Simmonds becomes first Prime Minister.
